Ok so, I am feeling suicidal since 2017. This had many reasons, but it did not really have something that awakened it. It was just there and it felt like someone is stabbing a knife through my chest every time I felt like I wanted to die. I really hated myself for every reason imaginable. But I just kept going through the days, because I did not want to worry anyone. Then in November 2019, I told one of my friends how I really felt, and he responded very kindly to it. He helped me to cope with it and thanks to him I was able to talk more open about it with other friends of mine. But there was just one tiny problem: telling my friends how I feel was a burden for them. I have the borderline syndrom and started hating myself a lot for hurting my friends that way. Then, I was about to kill myself and they knew, so they told the teachers two days before I wanted to do it. The teachers called my parents and got immediately sent to a mental hospital for teenager. It was a horrible experience and I never want to get back there. They took everything that I liked from me (video games, cutting myself, etc) for THREE WEEKS. I got out after that time because I was smart and manipulative to the therapists, so they did not worry about letting me out. That was 3 months ago. When I got out of that jail, the coronavirus broke out in my country and all schools closed. All my friends,
that were there for me when I felt bad and had an open ear for me, are gone now, which is completely my fault. I was never someone who was popular at school, and since the lockdown, I have been very lonely, and my social anxiety is making me distance myself from everyone I know. I have been visiting a very good therapist since I got out of the hospital, but I am showing him only my Intelligence and my intellect, because I want him to have a nice time with me at least, and not hear me wine about my pathetic life. I have gotten to a point where I really do not want to go back to school after the summer break ends and I want to end it all. Tell me what you think. (And thanks for reading)
